dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Continuous, symmetrical 2D reduction in width from the mid-body toward the posterior terminus.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: One dark-pixel linear feature coinciding with the dorsal ridge; one circular low-intensity point anomaly on the left dorsal-lateral plane.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Subtle topological depression on the left lateral-dorsal surface relative to the central ridge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Longitudinal dark marking along the central dorsal ridge.
